exposure: Black, Asian or Other minority ethnic group
cohort: all hospitalized pregnant women with confirmed SARS-CoV-2 from 01/03/2020 to 31/08/2020 in the UK
finding: Hospitalized pregnant women with symptomatic SARS-CoV-2 were more likely to be admitted to intensive care, but the absolute risk of poor outcomes was low.
mod_finding: Cesarean births were increased in women with both symptomatic and asymptomatic SARS-CoV-2.
